subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — core event contracts

question: Should AI-safety events remain core-only except for a manifest-authorized plugin API, or may every installed plugin use the existing public trusted diagnostic emitter?
rationale: The linked design issue still requires product and security decisions, and the current Plugin SDK exposes a generic trusted emitter whose semantics conflict with the PR's stated authorization model.

options.title: Core plus gated plugin API
options.body: Keep AI-safety trusted emission internal and permit external plugins only through the declared-event manifest gate proposed in the companion PR.

options.title: Trust every installed plugin
options.body: Allow the existing public trusted emitter to submit AI-safety findings and remove claims that manifest authorization is the exclusive plugin path.

options.title: Defer the taxonomy
options.body: Pause the series until event names, privacy rules, schema versioning, and authorization semantics are sponsored as one stable contract.

recommendation.title: Core plus gated plugin API
recommendation.body: Keep AI-safety trusted emission internal and permit external plugins only through the declared-event manifest gate proposed in the companion PR.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-wide public SDK and security-boundary choice requiring explicit product sponsorship.
